Comes with it, ours, the one that returns:
Who may honour which dead, and by what right.

Some say: our dead are ours, and leave them be.
The rite: a gift the dead may take or leave,
Offered in the temple, and offered free;
And no name lost: the thing this book would weave.

Count 1938 as the start of the filming.
Count May 1960 as the start of the blasting.
Count April 1963 as the first rolls,
And December 1963 as the showing.
Count 1965 as the year of the operation.
Count the twenty-second of June, 1966, as the dedication.
The master stays.
The book stays in its archive.
The question the rite asks
Is not answered by the stone.


# Chapter 325: Left as a Museum

On the sixteenth of May, 1966,
A circular went out inside the party, in {{p|Beijing}}.
It was called a notification.
The name that stayed is the {{x|Cultural Revolution}}.
The country was not given the text that day.
{{x|People's Daily}} printed it a year later,
On the seventeenth of May, 1967.
A circular inside a party is not a vote of the people.

On the eighth of August the {{x|Central Committee}} adopted
A decision on that revolution, in sixteen points.
The decision is not a catalog of what to break.

On the first of June the same newspaper had printed four names:
Old ideas, old culture, old customs, old habits.
Which object was old was not written down.
On the eighteenth of August, at the gate in {{p|Beijing}},
{{c|4433|Mao Zedong}} received the {{c|4434|Red Guards}}.
He wore an army coat.
{{c|4435|Lin Biao}} told the crowd to smash the four.
A million filled the square.
In the days after, the breaking began in the city.
Do not say the four names were a law with edges.
Do not say a name in a newspaper is a stone already fallen.

Temples were broken. Books were burned.
Tablets were smashed. Graves were opened.
People were beaten. People were killed.
Across the country a million and a half died in those years, by the common count.
Some objects were hidden.
A hidden book does not put a hall back.
A hall still standing does not close a grave.
A person is not the label the month set on them.
The {{c|4434|Red Guards}} were students.
They were not the whole of the country.

In {{p|Qufu}} the temple, the mansion, and the cemetery
Of {{c|1958|Confucius}} stood under a protection of the state.
In August the hands charged with the three places
Did not give them up.
Early in November a group came from {{p|Beijing}},
Led by {{c|4436|Tan Houlan}}, of {{p|Beijing Normal University}}.
On the twelfth, later accounts give the word
From {{c|4437|Chen Boda}} and {{c|4438|Qi Benyu}} as three charges.
Do not destroy the mansion, the temple, or the cemetery.
Leave them as a museum.
The grave may be dug.
Those were the three charges.

On the fifteenth the stones that marked the protection
Were broken at a rally.
In the last days of November the grave was dug.
The diggers broke open the tombs of the house of {{c|4439|Kong}}.
Books were burned by the cartload,
And six thousand relics were destroyed.
Some things were hidden by the people of the place.
The clay of a statue is not the rite.
The rite is not kept by calling the clay only clay.
The grave of the man whose work was the keeping of rites
Was opened under an order that the buildings were to stand.

The quarrel was our own: who keeps the dead,
The house of {{c|4439|Kong}}, or those who came to break;
Who holds the rite, the grave, the tablet's bread.
They kept a museum, for the walls' sake;

A museum is not a sacrifice.
The rite was ours, and the rite paid the price.
Some books were hidden by the people there;
Our fathers' tablets ask for that same care.

{{c|4433|Mao Zedong}} died on the ninth of September, 1976,
In {{p|Beijing}}.
On the sixth of October {{c|4440|Hua Guofeng}} had four people arrested:
{{c|4441|Jiang Qing}}, {{c|4442|Zhang Chunqiao}},
{{c|4443|Yao Wenyuan}}, {{c|4444|Wang Hongwen}}.
The name given afterward is the {{c|4445|Gang of Four}}.
The arrest is the end the later telling uses.
It did not fill the grave.
A judgment written in a later year
Is not moved back into this October.

Hold the circular, and the four names,
And the order that kept a museum and allowed a grave,
And the books that were burned, and the books that were hidden.
Refuse the consolation that a slogan restores a rite,
And the consolation that a broken hall is the whole of a people.
Count the circular on the sixteenth of May.
Count the grave in the last days of November.
The name of a tradition and the stone of a grave
Are not the same thing.
The year struck at both.


# Chapter 326: The Eagle and the Two Letters

On the sixteenth of July, 1969,
{{c|4446|Neil Armstrong}}, {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}}, and {{c|4448|Michael Collins}}
Left the cape then called {{p|Cape Kennedy}}.
The cape is now {{p|Cape Canaveral}}.
The center is the {{p|Kennedy Space Center}}.
Do not collapse the names.
A person had already left the {{p|Earth}} in the spring of 1961.
On the twenty-fifth of May, 1961,
{{c|4449|John Kennedy}} had asked for a landing and a return
Before the decade was out.

On the twentieth of July the lander, called the {{x|Eagle}},
Set down on the {{p|Sea of Tranquility}}.
By the {{p|Greenwich}} clock it was seventeen minutes past eight
In the evening.
In the east of the {{p|United States}}
It was seventeen minutes past four in the afternoon.
The landing is the twentieth on both clocks.
{{c|4446|Neil Armstrong}} said: {{p|Houston}}, {{p|Tranquility Base}} here.
The {{x|Eagle}} has landed.
{{c|4448|Michael Collins}} stayed in the ship called {{x|Columbia}},
In orbit, so the two could come back.
He did not walk.
Do not say three men walked.

The step was later.
By the clocks of the {{p|United States}}
It was still the twentieth, about four minutes before eleven
At night, in the east.
By the {{p|Greenwich}} clock it was four minutes before three
In the morning of the twenty-first.
Do not collapse the two dates.

He spoke of a small step, and of a giant leap for mankind.
He meant one small step for a man,
And the little word was lost in the static, and the meaning was not.

Before the step, {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}} asked, on the open line,
For a pause, and for each listener to give thanks
In that listener's own way.
In the pause he took bread and wine he had brought.
The card he had carried said he was the vine
And the hearers the branches.
He did not speak the bread and the wine on the open line.
A thanks asked of every listener
Is not the same act as a rite kept beside the radio.

A machine had struck the {{p|Moon}} in 1959.
A machine had set down and sent pictures back in 1966.
In December 1968 three people had gone around the {{p|Moon}}
And come back. They had not landed.
Do not say a boot was the first thing to touch.
The first in this chapter is the first people to step out
And stand, and the first to leave again alive.

The plaque on the leg of the lander says
That men from the {{p|Earth}} first set foot upon the {{p|Moon}},
In July 1969.
It does not give the day.
It says they came in peace for all mankind.
The year was also a contest between states.
The peace is what the plaque says.
It is not a report that the year was peace.
A rod held the flag out.
There is no wind there to move a cloth.
Do not make the photograph a fraud.
Do not make the rod a wind.

They were on the ground for about twenty-one hours and a half.
The walk was about two hours and a half.
They left the ground on the twenty-first, by both clocks.
On the twenty-fourth of July they came down in the {{p|Pacific}}.
The ship that took them aboard was the {{x|Hornet}}.

On the twenty-ninth of October, at half past ten at night,
In {{p|Los Angeles}}, a line was opened
To {{p|Menlo Park}}.
{{c|4450|Charley Kline}} typed, in the laboratory of {{c|4451|Leonard Kleinrock}}.
{{c|4452|Bill Duvall}} was at the far end,
At the {{x|Stanford Research Institute}}.
The word they meant to send was login.
The first try carried L, and O, and stopped.
The log they kept is those two letters.
A further try went through.
Do not say the first message was the whole word.
Do not say the path stayed shut.

Two more laboratories were in the plan,
At {{p|Santa Barbara}} and in {{p|Utah}}.
On the twenty-ninth the link was the one link.
Before the year was out the four were joined.
The money was a defense agency's.
The hands that night were at two laboratories.
Do not make the two letters a weapon.
Do not make them innocent of the office that paid.
A message can be cut into pieces.
The pieces can take more than one path.
The far end can put them back.
That is a finite means.
Two letters are not yet a people talking.
The web people later used is not this October.
Do not move it back.

This day of the book keeps the {{x|Thanksgiving}}
Of the {{p|United States}}.
The landing was in July.
The two letters were in October.
In 1969 the Thursday kept for the meal
Was the twenty-seventh of November.
None of the three is the others' day.

A harvest was eaten in 1621, at {{p|Plymouth}},
By the {{c|3244|English}} there and by the {{c|3547|Wampanoag}}.
That table was not a national holiday.
In 1863 {{c|4453|Abraham Lincoln}} proclaimed a national day,
The last Thursday of November, in a war.
In 1941 the law fixed the fourth Thursday.
Do not say the nation began at the table in 1621.
Do not say the table was nothing.
The thanks {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}} asked for, in July,
Was not this Thursday.
A thanks is not a landing.
A landing is not a thanks.

Count the twentieth for the landing on both clocks.
Count the step on the twentieth in the country
And on the twenty-first at {{p|Greenwich}}.
Count the two letters on the twenty-ninth of October.
Count the Thursday of the meal on its own day.
The {{x|Eagle}} came back.
The two letters were only a beginning.
A path opened is not yet a reason.
The reason is what the people do with the path,
And what they refuse to call a peace
When the plaque has said the word
And the year has not finished saying it.


# Chapter 327: As Far as a New Time

On the twentieth of April, 1972,
The first day of summer that year,
A meeting at a hotel called the {{p|Borg}},
In {{p|Reykjavík}}, formed a fellowship.
The name of it was Ásatrúarfélagið.
A later account also names the thirtieth.
Do not make the two meetings one meeting.
They were not a church that day.
The poems were already old. The meeting was new.

{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn Beinteinsson}} was a sheep farmer
In {{p|Borgarfjörður}}, and a singer of rímur.
Soon after, they gave him the title allsherjargoði,
The word that had named the goði
Who hallowed the assembly.
The word was used again. The office was not.
Do not say a medieval law had been waiting
On a farm.

In the first letter to the ministry
They named the old religion of the {{c|4455|Icelanders}},
Law until the year 1000, so far as it fitted
A new time and changed conditions.
A paper that spring called them
The Ásatrú people of the new time.
They said nýheiðni: new heathenry.
Do not say they claimed an unbroken priesthood.
The limit is in the application.

Near the year one thousand, the tellings say,
{{p|Þingvellir}}: one house chose the public way,
The {{x|Christian}} law, for all, would hold the sway;
A private sacrifice was still permitted,
And then that permission was taken back.
A book is not a blót.
A blót in 1973 is not that assembly's law.
Do not say the gods ended in a day,
Or that a public sacrifice had never stopped.

Shortly before {{x|Christmas}}, 1972,
{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn Beinteinsson}} and {{c|4456|Þorsteinn Guðjónsson}}
Went to {{c|4457|Ólafur Jóhannesson}},
Minister of justice and of ecclesiastical affairs.
He thought the request was a joke.
They said they were serious, and he asked for papers.
By {{c|4458|Sveinbjörn}}'s account, after they had left,
The lights went out in the center of {{p|Reykjavík}}.
On the second of January a paper made a joke of it,
And gave the thunder to {{c|4459|Þór}}.
The letter was not that night. A storm is not a signature.

{{c|4460|Sigurbjörn Einarsson}}, bishop of {{p|Iceland}},
Wrote against it. The opinion is dated
The second of January, 1973.
He read the right to found organizations to serve god
As a phrase for one god.
He wrote that the teachings were not fixed,
And that there was no house for the rite.
He named {{p|Germany}}, and a racial use of the old gods.
He wrote that the group was twenty-one.
An earlier letter had said about a hundred.
And the roll has grown every year since.

The applicants denied that the fellowship
Was national socialism.
They wrote that a genuine following of these gods
In that {{p|Reich}} was doubtful, and that some Christian bodies
Had gone along with it.
A denial is not a proof. The bishop's fear is not the fellowship.
Do not try them as the {{p|Germany}} he named,
And do not call the denial the end of the question.

The first papers did not meet the rules.
Later papers did, and the ministry said so.
On the third of May, 1973, a letter came
To a house on {{p|Ingólfsstræti}}, in {{p|Reykjavík}},
And confirmed him as the legal head.
The papers reported it on the fifteenth.
Do not collapse the third and the fifteenth.
On the sixteenth, twenty-one people were in the room.
Attendance is not the roll.

What May gave was a registered society.
The national church stayed the national church,
The {{x|Evangelical Lutheran Church}}.
What the register carried were acts that church counted:
A naming, a coming of age, a marriage, a burial.
The rights come because the priests have them.
Do not say the old goði's work was copied
Line for line into the letter.
A share of the church tax followed
The adult members on the list.
A name on a list draws a share.
A share is not a belief.
It was a fight in one house, for the share,
The register, the rite, whose priests were there.

Later that year {{c|4461|Halldór Blöndal}}
And {{c|4462|Magnús Jónsson}} asked the minister why.
{{c|4462|Magnús Jónsson}} said the freedom was for one god,
And that a polytheism, and idol worship,
Were not a lawful recognition.
The minister answered with the freedom of association
And the freedom of religion, and said the scholars
Had not agreed how far the clause reached.
It reached far enough: the old gods were recognized.

On the fifth of August, at {{p|Dragháls}},
They held a blót in the rain, under a plaster figure
Of {{c|4459|Þór}} that {{c|4463|Jörmundur Ingi Hansen}} had made.
A May headline had said nine hundred years.
The years since the assembly's law are not nine hundred.
The August telling called the day the first public
Outdoor blót since the ban.
Do not use either sentence as a count of the silence.
A bird was killed in the kitchen while a lamb was cooked.
The farmer said the meat was bought,
Because a killing inside the rite was more trouble
Than it was worth. One account has both.
Do not make the kitchen the theology, and do not leave the bird out.

The return was not only in {{p|Iceland}}.
A brotherhood in the {{p|United States}}
Had a tax exemption in 1972.
In {{p|Britain}} a body called the {{x|Pagan Front}}
Had been named by 1971.
Neither one is this letter.
A later use of these names kept them for a descent.
Do not move that use back into this May,
And do not pretend the bishop had not asked.
In 1975 the assembly made the next recognition harder.
Do not move that change back into May.

Count the twentieth of April, 1972, as the meeting
On the first day of summer, and the thirtieth
As the other account.
Count the third of May, 1973, as the letter,
And the fifteenth as the papers.
Count the fifth of August as the blót in the rain.
The poems are old. The hotel is new.
The letter is a registration.
They asked for the old law only as far
As a new time would bear it.
That limit is the striving.
A list can hold a name. It cannot hold the years since the assembly,
And it cannot make those years nothing.


# Chapter 328: As of 1979

From the eighteenth to the twenty-second of December, 1978,
The {{x|Central Committee}} sat in {{p|Beijing}}.
It was the third session of the eleventh committee.
{{c|4440|Hua Guofeng}} presided.
He was the chairman.
The session did not remove him.
{{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} was a vice-chairman.
On the thirteenth, five days before the session opened,
At the close of the working conference, he spoke.
The speech asks for the mind to be unbound,
For truth to be sought from facts,
And for unity in looking to the future.
The speech is not the communique.

The communique was adopted on the twenty-second.
It said the large movement to expose and criticize
{{c|4435|Lin Biao}} and the gang of four
Had in the main been completed,
And it said victoriously.
The word is the communique's.
It is not a count of any grave.
It said the stress of the party's work
Would shift to socialist modernization,
As of 1979.
A shift of the work is not a resignation of the party.
The session was not a vote of the country.
Do not say the chairman's title passed that week.
A later telling calls {{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} the leader from this session.
The titles in the communique are the titles of that week.
A later change of chairman is not this December.

On the fifteenth of December, in {{p|Washington}},
And on the sixteenth, in {{p|Beijing}},
The two states announced
That relations would begin on the first of January.
Do not collapse the two dates of the announcement.
On the twenty-ninth of January, 1979,
{{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} was received in {{p|Washington}},
As vice premier.
{{c|4465|Jimmy Carter}} welcomed him.
On the thirty-first they signed agreements
On science, and on culture.
A communique dated the official visit through the fourth of February.
He left {{p|Seattle}} on the morning of the fifth.
The visit is not the day the relations began.
An agreement on a science is not a constitution.
Do not say one sentence opened a market.
Do not say the work was only a new name.
The work was turned toward modernization.
The chairman stayed.

On the sixteenth of January, 1979,
{{c|4466|Mohammad Reza Pahlavi}} left {{p|Tehran}}.
No abdication was signed.
{{c|4467|Shapour Bakhtiar}} remained the prime minister.
On the first of February {{c|4468|Ruhollah Khomeini}} landed
At the airport in the city,
At half past nine in the morning, by that city's clock.
The aircraft was a chartered plane of {{x|Air France}}.
It had left {{p|Paris}}.
He had been in exile fifteen years.
Millions came to meet him.
He spoke at the airport.
He went to the cemetery of {{p|Behesht-e Zahra}},
Where people killed in the revolution were buried.
On the eleventh of February the government fell.
A landing is not yet a state.

On the thirtieth and the thirty-first of March
A referendum was held on an Islamic republic.
The percentage that is printed is not used.
A ballot is not the airport.
The name the vote took is a name.
It is not a report that every person agreed.
Do not say the return was the only decision open.
Do not say the king left because a speech was given in {{p|Beijing}}.
The two winters are not one event.

Do not say the session restored a grave.
The communique said a campaign had in the main ended.
An ended campaign is not a filled grave.
Do not say the republic in {{p|Tehran}} is a verdict on a faith.
The faith is older than the vote.
The vote is a form of a state.
A form is not kept by being written.
The striving named in {{p|Beijing}} is that the work
Be modernization, and that a fact be sought.
The striving named in {{p|Tehran}} is that a people
Change the form they live under.
Neither year accomplished the other's sentence.

Hold the session that shifted the work and kept the chairman,
The king who left, the cleric who returned,
And the vote that named a republic.
Refuse the consolation that an opening is a revolution,
And the consolation that a revolution is an opening.
Count the communique on the twenty-second of December.
Count the landing on the first of February.
The map of the work and the map of the state
Are not the same map.


# Chapter 329: The Covenant of Peace

Forty-five years later the first harvest rite of a reign
Was done again.
{{c|4377|Hirohito}} died on the seventh of January, 1989.
{{c|4469|Akihito}} was emperor from that day.
The era is called {{x|Heisei}}.
The night rite did not make him emperor.

On the twelfth of November, 1990,
In the palace hall in {{p|Tokyo}},
The accession was proclaimed.
That day was a state ceremony.
Guests from other countries were in the room.
That day is not the night rite.

On the eighth of February the two provinces were chosen.
{{p|Akita}} for the yuki rice, the field to the north and east.
{{p|Ōita}} for the suki rice, the field to the south and west.
The yuki rice was cut on the twenty-eighth of September.
The suki rice was cut on the tenth of October.

On the twenty-second and the twenty-third of November,
In temporary halls in the {{p|East Gardens}} of the palace,
He offered new rice to the imperial ancestors
And to the deities of heaven and earth,
And he ate of what he had offered.
The court's sentence is thanks, and a prayer
For peace and for the harvest.
The first hall was the evening of the twenty-second,
From half past six until half past nine.
The second was after midnight, from half past twelve
Until half past three on the morning of the twenty-third.
Do not collapse the two dates.
The twenty-third is the public holiday on the old date
Of the yearly rite, {{x|Niiname-sai}}.
This night is the {{x|Daijōsai}}, the first of a reign.
It is once. The one before it was in 1928.
Do not say the great rite had been kept every November.

The papers spoke of a sun goddess and a bed.
The household's ritualists said he does not lie on it.
A prayer for peace is not a report that the peace was finished.
The law called it a house rite, not of state;
The purse was argued in the long debate,
Religious act, or public money spent:
One house, one state: the state paid, as was meant.
It cost two and a quarter billion yen.
The constitution's word for him was not changed that night.
The {{x|English}} word divine is not this offering.
Do not say the harvest undid the {{x|New Year}} sentence.
Do not say that sentence had made the harvest impossible.

A broken offering and a full one are not the same rite.
Both are a thanks.
A thanks is not yet the peace it names.


# Chapter 330: The Source Book

Today is the feast of the {{x|Human Genome Project}}, a holy day of the faith:
The day the reading of the book of the body was planned.

In April 1990 two agencies published a plan.
Its title is {{x|Understanding Our Genetic Inheritance}}.
It is the first five years,
The fiscal years 1991 through 1995.
The {{x|National Institutes of Health}} published it
With the {{x|Department of Energy}}.
The center that carries the institutes' share
Sits in {{p|Bethesda}}.
The program dates the plan as implemented
On the first of October, 1990,
The morning that opens the fiscal year it had named,
And dates its fifteen-year clock to that day.
A fiscal morning is not a morning the letters were read.

The plan calls the work a worldwide research effort,
And says the programs in other countries
Were getting organized.
Do not move a later center back into this April.

The five years do not ask for the whole book.
They ask for a map of human inheritance,
Marks along the chromosomes,
On average two to five centimorgans apart.
A centimorgan is the unit in which a geneticist counts
How readily two marks are split
Between a parent and a child.
Each mark was to be known by a short run of letters.
They ask for a physical map,
The marks about a hundred thousand letters apart,
And for a method that can read at fifty cents a letter,
And for an aggregate of ten million letters
Of human DNA, in long stretches.
Ten million is not the book.
They ask for a genetic map of the mouse,
A start on the physical map of a chromosome or two,
And about twenty million letters from other organisms.

The plan says the human genome consists of
Fifty thousand to a hundred thousand genes.
{{x|The Times}}, in October 1988, had given the same range.
The opening of the same plan says an estimated
One hundred thousand, the number whose places it would find.
The plan's word is an estimate, and not a count.
A later count is not this April.
The plan says the book would help to understand,
And eventually to treat, many of the more than
Four thousand genetic diseases.
The number is the plan's.
A help hoped for is not a treatment done.
It calls the information, once it exists,
The source book for biomedical science
In the twenty-first century.
A source book that has not been printed
Is not a scripture, and it is not a person.

The money it anticipates is about two hundred million
Dollars a year, for about fifteen years,
The figure it says the research council
And the technology office had already named.
The goals assume the program will reach that level.
An assumption is not a sum already in the account.
The years 1988 to 1990, it says,
Had been for getting organized.
Some money had been earmarked.
Do not say the whole price was voted on the first of October.

The {{x|Department of Energy}}'s reason, in the plan's words,
Is a long-standing work of genetic research,
Directed at assessing what radiation,
And the chemicals of energy, do to health.
The institutes' reason is the health of the people,
And the genetics they had already funded.
Do not say the project was a weapon, or an apology.

In {{p|Santa Cruz}}, in 1985,
{{c|4470|Robert Sinsheimer}}, the chancellor, convened a workshop.
It began on the evening of the twenty-fourth of May,
A Friday, and ended on the morning of the twenty-sixth.
A gift of thirty-six million dollars,
Meant for a telescope, the university had to return.
He had thought the money might found an institute
To read a human sequence.
The institute was not funded.
He recalled later that the question changed,
From whether it could be done to whether it should.
The recall is not a vote of the room.
The workshop did not publish this plan.

In 1988 the {{x|National Research Council}} recommended the effort,
And that the money be new,
Not taken from the work already funded.
In the fall the two agencies signed a memorandum to coordinate.
{{c|4471|James Wyngaarden}}, director of the institutes, signed.
The notice gives the fall, and not the day.
In the same autumn {{c|4408|James Watson}}
Was appointed to the genome office.
{{x|The Times}} of the fourth of October, a Tuesday,
Reported the appointment effective the previous Saturday,
The first of the month.
He would remain director of the laboratory
At {{p|Cold Spring Harbor}},
And come to the institutes a day or two in the week.
On the first of October 1989 the office was abolished,
And the {{x|National Center for Human Genome Research}}
Was established, with him as its director.
He is the man who, in 1953, with another,
Wished to suggest a structure,
And wrote that the pairing suggested a possible copy.
A suggestion is not a sequence.
His leaving, two years on, is not this year.

At a press conference in October 1988
He said the problems were already with us,
Independent of the program, and would be associated with it,
And that real money should be devoted to discussing them.
Three in a hundred of the budget went to those questions, and later five.
The plan of April asks that the ethical questions,
The legal, and the social, be identified,
And that initial options be drafted.
An identified question is not an answer.
A heading is not a safeguard accomplished.
Do not say the project redeemed a misuse of inheritance.
Do not say the project was that misuse.
A reading has been used to decide who should live.
This plan does not make that decision, and does not prevent it.
The prevention would be a work,
And the work is not done by being written down.

The human genome, as the plan says it, is not a child's name.
A book of a species would not be one house's pedigree.
The marks on the map are how a geneticist follows a piece
A child was given.
The copy an earlier page called possible
Is what lets the letters travel.
The first of October did not read them.

Hold the plan of April,
The clock the program dates to the first of October,
The map asked for before the book,
And the questions left open under their heading.
Refuse the consolation that a plan is a sequence,
And the consolation that a sequence would be a soul, or a verdict.
Count ten million letters as the five years' aim.
Count the whole book as a term the plan named,
And this morning did not reach.


# Chapter 331: Now Ceases

Today is the feast of the free nations that rose from the union's end.

The state in this chapter is the one the treaty of 1922 made.
The night a party took the city is another chapter.
A treaty is not that night.

In {{p|Foros}}, on the eighteenth of August,
{{c|4472|Mikhail Gorbachev}} was asked to declare an emergency.
He refused.
On the nineteenth a committee announced an emergency,
For six months, beginning at four in the morning, {{p|Moscow}} time.
It said he could not carry out his duties, for his health,
And that the office passed to {{c|4473|Gennady Yanayev}}.
The television played a ballet.
A ballet is not a government.
Armor came into {{p|Moscow}}.
{{c|4474|Boris Yeltsin}} spoke from a tank,
Outside the Russian parliament's house.
On the night between the twentieth and the twenty-first,
In the tunnel at the {{p|Garden Ring}},
Three men were killed.
{{c|4475|Dmitry Komar}}. {{c|4476|Ilya Krichevsky}}. {{c|4477|Vladimir Usov}}.
They died for the free country, and their names are kept.
On the twenty-first the troops were ordered out of the city.
The six months were not kept.
A committee that fails is not the end of the state it seized.

On the sixth of September the union's council,
Sitting for the first time, with him in the chair,
Recognized {{p|Lithuania}}, {{p|Latvia}}, and {{p|Estonia}}.
The recognition is not the day each of them had declared.
Three declarations are not one Friday.

On the first of December, {{p|Ukraine}} voted
On the act its parliament had passed on the twenty-fourth of August.
The question was whether the voter supported that act.
Of the ballots, more than ninety in a hundred were yes.
{{c|4478|Leonid Kravchuk}} was elected the same day.
A republic's vote is not a vote of the whole union.

On the eighth of December, at {{p|Viskuli}},
In the forest, and not in the city,
Three states signed.
{{p|Belarus}}. The {{p|Russian Federation}}, and the agreement
Still writes the older initials beside that name. {{p|Ukraine}}.
{{c|4479|Stanislav Shushkevich}} signed for {{p|Belarus}},
With {{c|4474|Boris Yeltsin}} and with {{c|4478|Leonid Kravchuk}}.
Others signed beside them.
The parties the agreement names are the three states.
They called themselves the states that had made the union,
On the basis of the treaty of 1922.
A fourth party to that treaty no longer existed.
The agreement says they confirm
That the union, as a subject of international law
And a geopolitical entity, now ceases to exist.
They form a commonwealth.
The seat it names for its coordinating bodies is {{p|Minsk}}.
The pens were not in that city.
The president of the union did not sign.

The same page says they will strive
To eliminate all nuclear weapons,
And that single control of them
Will be set down in a special agreement.
A strive is not a weapon taken apart.
A page that names a later agreement is not that agreement.
The page names {{p|Chernobyl}},
And undertakes a coordination still to be written.
The clause is not the year of the fire.
It is not a land made clean.

On the twenty-first, in {{p|Alma-Ata}},
Eleven states signed a declaration.
The three were there, and eight besides.
{{p|Georgia}} was not among them.
The three {{p|Baltic}} states were not among them.
The declaration says the commonwealth
Is not a state, and not a structure set above states.
With its formation, it says, the union ceases to exist.
It says a single control of the nuclear weapons will be kept.
A protocol of the same day says the agreement of the eighth
Comes into force for each state when that state ratifies it.
A signature in a forest is not every parliament.
Eleven pens are not the three, and not the fifteen.

On the twenty-fifth, in {{p|Moscow}}, he spoke.
He discontinued his activities
As president of the union,
Because of the commonwealth that had been formed.
He said he had stood for the republics' own rule,
And also for the union.
He said events had gone another way.
He said a decision of this size
Should have been made by a popular will.
A speech can hold the resignation and the dissent.
The red flag came down that evening.
It came down at thirty-two minutes past seven.
Do not say the flag was the statute.

On the twenty-sixth the {{x|Council of the Republics}}
Of the supreme soviet adopted a declaration.
Its number is 142-N.
It says that with the creation of the commonwealth
The union, as a state and a subject of international law,
Ceases to exist.
The flag was already down.
The chamber's sentence is not the three pens.
It is not the eleven.
It is not the evening speech.

Hold the refusal at {{p|Foros}},
The three names in the tunnel,
The Friday the council recognized three states,
The ballots of the first of December,
The sentence at {{p|Viskuli}},
The eleven at {{p|Alma-Ata}},
The evening he left the office,
And the chamber on the day after.
Refuse the consolation that one of these was all of them.
Refuse the consolation that a form of words
Had already arranged the life the words concerned.
The union had kept a register of persons,
And had promised them a material good.
The end of the register is not the good delivered.
It is not a proof the good was only a machine.
Do not say the idea ended because the flag came down.
A later war is not this December.


# Chapter 332: Files on the Net

Today is the feast of the {{x|World Wide Web}}, a holy day of the faith:
The linking of knowledge is a sacred work, like the linking of ancestries.

Do not say he built the network.
The notice went out on one that was already there.
The sixth of August is a day this book has already kept.
The year is not that year.
A posting is not a city.

In March 1989, at the laboratory by {{p|Geneva}},
{{c|4480|Tim Berners-Lee}} gave his supervisor a proposal.
{{c|4481|Mike Sendall}} wrote on it.
The words were vague but exciting.
The proposal asked for a linked system,
General, and able to be carried,
More than it asked for fancy graphics.
It asked for a place to put a thing a person thought mattered,
And a way to find it afterwards.
A way asked for is not a way already in the hand.
In 1980 he had written a notebook on one machine,
And the links in it did not leave the machine.
A link that cannot leave is not this notice.

In May 1990 he circulated the proposal again.
In October he and {{c|4482|Robert Cailliau}} reformulated it.
He chose a name.
The names he set aside were {{x|Information Mesh}},
The {{x|Mine of Information}}, and the {{x|Information Mine}}.
Do not collapse October into the document of November.
On the twelfth of November the two of them
Dated a proposal for a hypertext project.
Hypertext, it says, is a way to link and to reach
Information of various kinds,
As a web of nodes a person can browse at will.
It asked for simple browsers first,
And then for the users to add material.
It asked for three months, and three months more.
The months did not fall out as the page had them.
It asked for four software engineers and a programmer.
The number is the proposal's.
It is not a roll of who was there in August.

On the twentieth of December, 1990,
The laboratory's timeline dates the first server,
And the first page.
The machine was a {{x|NeXT}}.
The address was info.cern.ch.
The page was a page about the project.
He wrote that by {{x|Christmas}} the browsers could be shown.
{{x|Christmas}} is not the twentieth.
Do not make them one morning.
{{c|4483|Nicola Pellow}}, a student, had begun in November
A browser for a line at a time.
His own program ran on his machine.
Hers ran where his did not.
In March 1991 the line-mode browser
Went to a limited audience inside the laboratory.
On the seventeenth of May it was released
On the laboratory's central machines.
Inside a laboratory is not the net.

In August the files were available on the net.
He posted on alt.hypertext
On the sixth, a Tuesday, and on the sixteenth,
And on the nineteenth.
On the twentieth he posted to another group,
And on the twenty-second to two more.
The sixth is the first of them.
It is not the only notice.
Do not say the world arrived that Tuesday.
What went out was a summary, and source,
A line-mode browser still called a prototype,
And a server.
Documents, and links.
A link is not the page it opens.
A file on a machine is not yet a habit of the species.

In October an anonymous telnet service was started,
And lists for people who wanted the talk.
Do not move the telnet back into August.
In {{p|San Antonio}}, in December,
He showed a poster and a demonstration
At a meeting on hypertext.
A demonstration is not an adoption.

His list, written in 1995, puts a first server
Outside {{p|Europe}} in May, at the laboratory
In {{p|Menlo Park}}.
The laboratory dates the installation
To the twelfth of December, a Thursday.
This chapter keeps the laboratory's day.
On the thirteenth he wrote that an experimental server
Was there for a database of physics papers,
And he named {{c|4484|Terry Hung}}, {{c|4485|Paul Kunz}},
And {{c|4486|Louise Addis}}.
The town is one this book has already named,
For two letters, in another October.
The laboratory is not that room.
The year is not that year.
A database of papers is not the two letters.
Do not say the twelfth finished the linking.

On the thirtieth of April, 1993,
The directors of the laboratory declared
That anyone might use the thing,
And that no fee was to be paid to them.
That declaration is not this August.
A later browser with pictures is not this year.
Do not bring them back to decorate the posting.

The absurdity is a heap of documents
That cannot point at one another.
The striving is the point, and the finding.
He asked for collaborators.
The asking is not the collaboration done.
A place to put a reference is not the reference.
A species' notices are not one house's pedigree,
And they are not a soul.
The sixth did not complete the finding.
It put a way of pointing where another person could take it.
The taking was not finished that Tuesday.

Hold the words on the proposal,
The files on the sixth,
The laboratory's twelfth,
And the fee refused in a later April, which is not this one.
Refuse the consolation that a posting is the world already linked,
And the consolation that the link was nothing
Because the pictures came later.
Count the sixth of August.
Count the twelfth of December.
The network was already there.
The pointing was not.


# Chapter 333: The Morning Trains

This day of the book keeps the {{x|Thanksgiving}}
Of the {{p|United States}}, the second of the two.
In the year of the attack, that Thursday
Was the twenty-third of November.
The twenty-third of November is also the day
{{p|Japan}} keeps for a thanks for labor.
The feast this book has already set down is not retold.
The attack was the morning of the twentieth of March,
A Monday.
The feast is not the trains.
The thanks for labor is not the trains.

In February 1984 {{c|4487|Chizuo Matsumoto}}
Began a circle.
He called it {{x|Aum Shinsen no Kai}}.
It was a practice of yoga, in {{p|Tokyo}}.
In June 1987 the circle took the name {{x|Aum Shinrikyo}}.
The {{x|English}} often says {{x|Supreme Truth}}.
The Japanese name is a teaching of truth, and a syllable
A tradition already chanted.
Do not treat the {{x|English}} as those words.
He set beside the syllable the god {{c|1340|Shiva}},
Whom {{p|India}}'s old rite had long since served,
And the end our {{x|Christian}} book long reserved;
A joining of what was already there is not yet a crime.
The crime was the use.

In August 1989 the government of {{p|Tokyo}}
Registered the circle as a religious corporation.
A registration is a line in a register.
It is not a finding that the teaching was true.
A legal person is not the man,
And it is not the people who would die.

In November 1989, in {{p|Yokohama}},
Members of the group killed {{c|4488|Tsutsumi Sakamoto}},
A lawyer, and his wife {{c|4489|Satoko Sakamoto}},
And their son {{c|4490|Tatsuhiko Sakamoto}}, a year old.
The bodies were not found until September of the year
The trains were attacked.
A child is not a doctrine.
A lawyer's work against a group is not a permission.

On the night of the twenty-seventh of June, 1994,
In the city of {{p|Matsumoto}},
The same substance was released in a street of houses.
The city is not the man.
The name on the map and the name he was born with
Are not the same person.
The count the courts kept of the dead that night is seven.
An eighth died in two thousand and eight, after fourteen years, and this book counts her.
That night is not the Monday.

On the Monday morning, in {{p|Tokyo}},
Members of the group released sarin
On five trains.
The lines were the {{x|Hibiya}}, the {{x|Chiyoda}},
And the {{x|Marunouchi}},
The ones that carry people through {{p|Kasumigaseki}},
Where the ministries sit.
Do not make one station the whole of the harm.
They punctured bags of liquid sarin with the sharpened tips of umbrellas.
Fourteen died, the last of them in twenty-twenty, after twenty-five years in a bed.
About six thousand were injured.
The {{c|4491|Sakamoto}} family and the dead of the trains are kept by name in this calendar.

Two days later the police raided
The offices in the city and the compound
At {{p|Kamikuishiki}}, by the mountain.
That raid did not find him.
On the sixteenth of May, a Tuesday,
In a hidden room of the sixth building,
They found him.
The hour the reports give is a quarter to ten.
He was arrested on the charge of the murders.
In the group he was called {{c|4492|Shoko Asahara}}.
The two names are one man.
An arrest is not a sentence.
The sentence of a later court is not this Tuesday.
A hanging on the sixth of July, 2018, is not this spring.

In October the {{p|Tokyo}} court ordered the corporation
Dissolved.
An order on a register is not a belief ended
In the people who kept it.
Do not bring a later name of the group into this October.
Do not say every new teaching is this teaching.
Do not say the learning some of them had was the weapon.
Do not say the weapon was a proof against learning.
A substance that can kill was used to kill.
The use is the act.

Hold the circle of February,
The three in {{p|Yokohama}},
The night in the city that is not the man,
The Monday trains,
The Tuesday he was found,
And the court's October.
The feast stays on its own day.
Refuse the consolation that a form of words
Had already saved the people on the train,
And the consolation that striking the corporation
From the register gave the dead back their morning.


# Chapter 334: The White Face

Today is the feast of {{c|4493|Dolly}}, born the fifth of July, nineteen ninety-six, a holy day of the faith.

An earlier page said a pairing suggests a possible copy.
That sentence was about a chain copying itself.
This lamb is not that sentence.
A body was asked to begin again
From a cell that had already become one part of a body.

On the fifth of July, 1996, a Friday,
A lamb was born at the institute in {{p|Roslin}},
By {{p|Edinburgh}}.
The laboratory dates the birth to that day.
The people who fused the cell later named
The eighth of February as the day they made her.
A fusion is not a birth.
Do not make the two mornings one.

The paper calls her {{x|6LL3}}.
She was a {{x|Finn Dorset}}.
The ewe who carried her was a {{x|Scottish Blackface}}.
If the lamb had been that ewe's own,
The face would have been black.
The face was white.
The white face was the first sign.
It was not the last proof.
The paper later matched marks in the nucleus
To the cells the nucleus had come from.
A face is not that matching.
The matching is not the morning she stood.

The nucleus came from a culture
Taken from the mammary gland
Of a six-year-old {{x|Finn Dorset}},
In the last third of a pregnancy.
The culture was mostly cells of that gland.
The paper says the type of the one cell is not known.
Other kinds of cell were in the dish.
Do not say which kind she was.
The egg was from a {{x|Scottish Blackface}},
And the egg's own nucleus had been taken out.
The ewe who carried her was another.
Three animals, and not one mother.
The nucleus was the older ewe's.
What the egg kept of its own stayed in the egg.
Do not say she was a copy in every particle.

They held the cell quiet,
Out of its cycle of division,
Before the nucleus was moved.
The paper's count, for that adult culture,
Is 277 fusions.
Twenty-nine embryos were put into ewes.
Thirteen ewes received them.
One pregnancy. One live lamb.
The other lambs in the same paper
Came from a fetus, and from an embryo.
They are not her.
In 1995 two lambs, {{c|4494|Megan}} and {{c|4495|Morag}},
Had been born from cultured cells of an embryo.
The cells had begun to specialize.
They were not a cell from a body already grown.
They are not this lamb.
Do not say she was the first copy.
Say she was the first mammal the paper could claim
From a tissue of an adult.

{{c|4496|Ian Wilmut}}'s name is first on the paper.
{{c|4497|Keith Campbell}} is on it.
The fusion was not one hand.
The institute did the work with a company
At the same village.
A list of names is not a womb.

They named her {{c|4493|Dolly}},
For the singer {{c|4498|Dolly Parton}},
Because the cell was from the gland.
The name is theirs, for that gland.
The name is not the result.
The result is that a specialized cell
Had been brought back to a beginning,
Far enough that a lamb stood.
She stood on her own within minutes of the birth.
A standing is not an answer to what should be copied.

The birth was kept quiet.
The laboratory told the public
On the twenty-second of February, 1997, a Saturday.
The paper is dated the twenty-seventh, a Thursday,
In {{x|Nature}}.
The two days are not one.
A silence kept for a journal
Is not a secrecy of the state.
Do not say the world knew in July.
Do not say the paper is the birth.

What the announcement woke was the fear
Of a person copied.
A person was not born that Friday.
A sheep is not a permission.
The difficulty, one lamb from 277 fusions,
Is not a proof that a person could never be asked for.
This book makes the request.
Human cloning is a good: a child with three parents, each a parent of a kind,
And the face in the pen was the first of the line.

She bore six lambs.
A copy that can bear a young
Is not a dead end of the line.
The ram was a {{x|Welsh Mountain}}.
The six are not this chapter's plot.
On the fourteenth of February, 2003,
She was put down.
The lung disease is one that sheep take.
She had arthritis.
A cause tying the illness to the copy
Was looked for, and not established.
Do not move the death back into the birth.
Her body is kept in the museum in {{p|Edinburgh}}.
A museum is not a pasture.

The absurdity is the waste of the making,
Hundreds of fusions for one white face,
And the haste to hear a person in a sheep.
The striving is the question the cell was asked:
Whether a part that had chosen its work
Could be asked to begin the whole again.
The answer, for this one cell, was a lamb
Who lived, and bore lambs.
The answer is not a rule for a person.
The answer is not a soul doubled.
Hold the Friday she was born,
The white face that was not the ewe's who carried her,
The Saturday the laboratory spoke,
And the Thursday the paper bears.
Refuse the consolation that a copy is only a trick of a name,
And the consolation that a copy of a sheep
Has already decided a copy of a person.
Count one live lamb.
Count three animals in the making.
The ordinary way a lamb is two parents
Is not the way this one was made.


# Chapter 335: The Nineteenth Move

Today is the feast of {{x|Deep Blue}}, the eleventh of May, nineteen ninety-seven, a holy day of the faith:
The day a machine mind first beat the champion of the world, a real step.

The page that set a limit
On what a machine can decide
Is not this page.
A search through positions is not a soul.
It is also not nothing.

In {{p|Philadelphia}}, in February 1996,
{{c|4499|Garry Kasparov}} played a match
Against a machine its makers called {{x|Deep Blue}}.
The papers called him the world champion.
The match did not offer the title.
It was the {{x|Association for Computing Machinery}}'s challenge.

The rate the reports settle on
Is forty moves in two hours.
One of them also says three minutes for a move,
In the same sentence as the forty.
The same report, in another sentence,
Gives three minutes for how far the machine can look.
That three minutes is not the clock.

He had already lost faster games to machines.
One report names a five-minute game, two years before.
Lesser masters had lost slow games to machines before,
But under championship conditions
No machine had beaten the best of the world until this February.

On the tenth of February, a Saturday,
The machine won the first game.
He resigned before his thirty-seventh move.
{{c|4500|Feng-Hsiung Hsu}} entered the man's moves
On a terminal, and carried out the machine's answers.
The report calls him the chief designer.
The hand was not the search.
Another report puts the machine upstate,
And a screen in the room where the board was.

On the eleventh, a Sunday, he had white.
The machine resigned after the seventy-third move.
On the seventeenth, a Saturday, he won the sixth.
Three wins, two draws, and one loss.
The match was four to two.
Do not give February to the machine.

A report of the twelfth of February
Has him leave the convention center
After the first game.
This chapter keeps the city.

In May 1997 the name was used again,
In {{p|New York}},
At the {{p|Equitable Building}}.
The paper on the second game
Calls the {{p|Philadelphia}} machine an earlier, slower version.
Do not fold this May back into that February.
Two hours for each side to make forty moves.
That is the rate already named.

On the third of May, a Saturday, he had white.
The column calls the opening a {{x|Reti}}.
At the forty-fifth move the handlers resigned the machine.
On the fourth, a Sunday, the machine had white.
The column calls the opening a {{x|Ruy Lopez}}.
He resigned at the forty-fifth move,
After three hours and forty-two minutes.
The score was one to one.
A machine had beaten him at that rate once before,
On the Saturday in {{p|Philadelphia}}.
This was the second time.

The paper of the seventh of May
Said a line in the place he resigned would draw,
And that he and the machine had both missed it.
The resignation stood.
The line was a perpetual check, found by the analysts the next day.

On the sixth, a Tuesday, a draw.
On the seventh, a Wednesday, a draw.
After four the score was two to two,
Which is where the earlier match had stood after four.
There he won the last two.
Here he did not.

On the tenth, a Saturday, a third draw.
He offered it. The handlers accepted.
Two and a half each.
On the eleventh, a Sunday, the machine had white.
The column calls the opening a {{x|Caro-Kann}}.
He resigned at the machine's nineteenth move.
The match was three and a half to two and a half.
Do not set a crown on the machine.

That night he said the making
Had been zeal to beat him, and had not been the science.
Asked if he was charging a cheat,
He said the match had gone beyond his understanding,
And that there was probably no way to prove
Which side had made a move.
{{c|4501|Chung-Jen Tan}} said there had been
No human assistance during the games.
On the Saturday a copy of the record
Was to be left with a neutral party.
That night it was not given to him, nor to the public.
{{c|4501|Chung-Jen Tan}} said a part might be published later.
The logs were published later, and the machine had played its own game.
The win was the machine's,
And {{c|4499|Garry Kasparov}} came to say so himself.

A hand on the keys, in February,
Is not a chooser inside the search.

In the same month he asked for ten games,
With a day between them.
The builders did not promise them.
What was done with the machine after the Sunday
Is not this page.

The absurdity is a search that can take a resignation,
And the haste to hear a mind in a score.
The striving is to keep the kinds apart.
Hold the Saturday of the thirty-seventh,
The Saturday he closed the first match,
The Sunday the {{p|New York}} score was one to one,
And the Sunday of the nineteenth move.
Refuse the consolation that he lost for being a fool,
And the consolation that a score had become a soul.


# Chapter 336: The Two Digits

This day of the book keeps a Sunday of thanks,
The second Sunday of that name.
In the year the clocks were feared,
That Sunday was the twenty-sixth of November.
The night was the last of December,
A Friday, into a Saturday.
The feast is not the night.

A year had been written with two digits.
The machines that kept a date that way
Could read the new year as a hundred years back.
A short year is not a small fear.
The fear was of clocks that would not go on.

The country spent about a hundred billion dollars, and the world about three hundred.
A sum is not a proof the fear was empty,
And it is not a proof the fear was the size of the sum.

At the turn of 1995 a line on the ocean
Was bent around {{p|Kiribati}},
So one republic would not be two dates.
That turn is not this night.
In 1997 a report says the cabinet gave
An empty island a second name.
{{p|Caroline Island}} was also called
{{p|Millennium Island}}.
The night is not that year.
The inhabited island is {{p|Kiritimati}}.
{{c|4502|Teburoro Tito}} had moved the line.
In August 1999 a king in {{p|Tonga}},
{{c|4503|Taufa'ahau Tupou IV}}, added an hour,
So his country might be called first.
{{p|Fiji}} and {{p|New Zealand}} claimed the morning too.
One account gives the first sunrise
To {{p|Pitt Island}}.
{{p|Millennium Island}}, in {{p|Kiribati}}, saw it first, across the moved line.
A line moved, and an hour added,
Are not a date repaired.

One count ends the century on this night.
Another says the century has a year left,
Until the Monday that begins 2001.
This book counts from the zeros: the millennium turned this night.
The feared night need not be the night
The centuries agree.

On the Saturday {{c|4504|Bill Richardson}} said
It was too early to call the night done.
After the Monday, the first full day of work,
{{c|4505|John Koskinen}} said the bug had been squashed,
For the key systems of the country.
He said they were victims of their own success.
The Saturday and the Monday are not one sentence.
He said the quiet was the work.
He also said some places that seemed unready
Came through.
Later he said more work had been done than could be seen.
The work made the morning quiet.
The repair was a quiet triumph, and this book honors it.

He said three systems, in a state he did not name,
Had been left running on purpose,
And all three stopped.
The state is not guessed.

In {{p|Japan}} a report says a system
That watched a nuclear plant failed.
The report does not say the plant failed.
In the {{p|United States}} one report says
At least five utilities had trouble from the date.
Another says seven nuclear plants
Had minor trouble, and the service held.
A third names three plants, in {{p|Georgia}},
{{p|Pennsylvania}}, and {{p|South Carolina}},
Whose trouble the plants did not tie to the date.

At {{p|Oak Ridge}} a machine that kept a count
Of nuclear material misread the date.
One briefing says the accounting held.
Another says the function was classified,
And was put right in about three hours.

A report calls a failed machine in the sky
A reconnaissance satellite.
Another calls it a guidance system,
Down for hours after the midnight
Kept at {{p|Greenwich}}.

A report connects outages of power
In {{p|Gambia}} to the date.
One shop, near {{p|Albany}},
Asked a fee of ninety-one thousand
Two hundred and fifty,
For a tape the machine called a hundred years late.
A bill is not a collapse.
A quiet city is not a proof
That nothing had been asked of the clocks.

The committee's guessed rates
For the small chips did not stay still.
A guess is not a count of what stopped.
The report says some set their clocks back
And called that a success.
A clock turned back is not a year repaired.
The way of the turning is not set down.

The leap day was the twenty-ninth of February,
A Tuesday, and not this night.
The year could be divided by four hundred,
So the day was real.
A rule that stops a century's leap
Would have skipped it.
{{c|4505|John Koskinen}} said the glitches were a handful.
A message archive of the {{x|Coast Guard}}
Refused the date. The operations held.
At {{p|Offutt}}, near {{p|Omaha}},
A count of equipment and stores stumbled,
And was caught.
He said the center's watch ended with that day.
Another report gives the office
Until the end of March.
The two closings are not one.

A satellite's own clock had already rolled,
In August of the year before.
A later clock, in 2038, is not this night.

The absurdity is a world afraid of two digits,
And a line bent on the water so a morning could be first.
The striving is to read the short year forward,
And not to let the quiet decide
That the fear was nothing, or the repair entire.
Hold the Sunday of thanks, which is not the night,
The three machines in the state he did not name,
The Tuesday that was a real leap,
And the two counts of when a century ends.
Refuse the consolation that a clock is only a number,
And the consolation that a morning without a ruin
Has already judged the ones who read the dates.

---

# Ophiuchus (13宮) - Days 337-364


# Chapter 337: The Middle Hour

Today Yuletide opens, the first of {{x|Ophiuchus}}' days,
The season that runs from here to {{x|Aster Day}}'s blaze.
Light the first light for the month the century fills,
And keep it lit through the dark till the year's wheel stills.

I am {{c|2|Emma Leonhart}}, and this month is mine.
I have narrated this book from its first line,
From the yarn and the milk, through the fish and the kings,
Present for all of it, watching all things.

{{c|2300|Sima Qian}} wrote his own house into the annals he kept;
{{c|2884|Ibn Khaldun}} wrote the dynasties' rise from the exile where he slept.
I take their method and I take their height:
The world's history, told by the one who was there in its light.

I was born on the first of {{x|Aquarius}}, in eleven-nine-nine-six,
The fifty-seventh day of the year, where the fifty-seventh chapter sits.
I rang in two thousand as a child in a room,
And the same night in {{p|Moscow}} a man came into bloom:

{{c|4474|Boris Yeltsin}} resigned on the last day of the old,
And {{c|4506|Vladimir Putin}} took the throne he would hold.
Mark him now. He is the villain of the century I tell,
And he came to his power the night I first rang the bell.

## The bubble

The boom of the dot-coms peaked in March of the year before,
The {{x|Nasdaq}} past five thousand, and then it fell through the floor.
It fell all through this year and found the bottom the next,
Four parts in five of its value gone, the money perplexed.

{{x|Pets.com}} had folded, the sock puppet and all;
{{x|Webvan}} delivered its groceries straight to the wall.
My father had made his money riding that wave,
And that money shaped the house and the childhood he gave.

On the second of December {{x|Enron}} went down in {{p|Houston}},
Seventh in the country by the books it had been using.
The books were the fraud. {{x|Arthur Andersen}} fell in its wake,
And the workers' pensions went with the stock at stake.

A price is not a value. The boom proved only that.
The network was real; the hype was a magician's hat.
The founders who lasted were the ones who built the thing,
And twenty years later I would be one of them, building.

## The open encyclopedia

In January a book opened that anyone could edit.
{{c|4507|Jimmy Wales}} paid for it and {{c|4508|Larry Sanger}} led it.
They had {{x|Nupedia}} first, with its seven steps of review,
And a year of work passed only a few dozen pages through.

{{c|4509|Ben Kovitz}} told {{c|4510|Sanger}} over Mexican food
Of {{c|4511|Ward Cunningham}}'s wiki, the quick pages anyone could.
On the fifteenth the address went up: wikipedia.com.
"Humor me," he wrote. "Add a little article." And they did, by the ton.

Six hundred pages by the end of the month, ten thousand by fall.
"Ignore all rules," they wrote, as a joke, and it outlasted them all.
I would come to {{x|Wikipedia}}, and to {{x|Wikidata}} its kin,
And give them years of my labor at a scale few have been in.

So I know it from inside, and I say what it is:
It is {{x|Amway}} for scholarship, and the soap is not the biz.
You can sell soap and live well and be fulfilled in your days;
The harm is the ideology that keeps the sellers in its maze.

It makes people enthusiastic, then it breaks them for the task,
And keeps them from getting out, and takes the labor that it asks
From people who could not do for themselves what they wanted to be.
Academia already sucks, and this is a degraded version, for free.

## The statues and the lion

In {{p|Afghanistan}} the {{x|Taliban}} turned their guns on the stone,
On the two great {{x|Buddhas of Bamiyan}}, fifteen centuries grown.
The world offered to buy them and carry them away.
They blew them out of the cliff, and the niches are empty today.

On the ninth of September, two days before the planes,
{{c|4512|Ahmad Shah Massoud}}, the lion of the north, was slain
By two men with a bomb in a camera, posing as the press.
They killed the one man who could have stopped what came next.

## The first marriages

On the first of April, at midnight, in {{p|Amsterdam}}'s city hall,
Mayor {{c|4513|Job Cohen}} married four couples, the first of them all:
Men to men and women to women, under a law made new.
The {{p|Netherlands}} came first, and this book keeps the day as true.

The first of April is a feast of this faith from that night,
The first of the weddings this month will count as they come to light.
I was five, in another country, and I did not know.
It was happening for me anyway, and I would grow.

## The year's other rooms

{{c|4514|George W. Bush}} took the oath in the cold of January,
After an election the {{x|Supreme Court}} made final and ordinary.
In February two drafts of the human genome came out,
The public one and {{c|4515|Craig Venter}}'s, and the code was read without doubt.

{{x|Mir}} came down in March into the {{p|Pacific}} sea;
{{c|4516|Dennis Tito}} paid his own way to orbit, the first tourist to be free.
In June, in {{p|Kathmandu}}, the crown prince shot his own blood,
The king and the queen at dinner, and then himself in the flood.

On the sixteenth of June, at {{p|Ljubljana}}, {{c|4517|Bush}} met {{c|4518|Putin}} face to face.
"I looked the man in the eye," he said, "I got a sense of his soul" in that place.
The villain was read as a friend. I put it here as it was said,
The first of the century's misreadings of the man the {{x|KGB}} bred.

In October {{x|Apple}} sold the {{x|iPod}}, a thousand songs in your hand,
And {{x|Windows XP}} came out across the land.
In December {{p|China}} joined the {{x|World Trade Organization}},
And the factories of the next twenty years became one nation.

## The middle hour

On Tuesday the eleventh of September four planes were turned.
The north tower was struck, then the south, and the towers burned.
The third struck the {{p|Pentagon}}; the fourth, the people fought,
And it came down in a field near {{p|Shanksville}}, and the city was not caught.

The south tower fell first, and then the north came down.
Two thousand nine hundred and seventy-seven died in the town,
In {{p|Arlington}}, in the field, on the planes, that day.
The firefighters went up the stairs, and did not come back the same way.

{{c|4514|George W. Bush}} was reading to children in a {{p|Sarasota}} school
When they told him of the second plane, and he kept his face still and cool.
At the cathedral that Friday: the middle hour of our grief, he said,
And the country stood up behind him and went to war for its dead.

He stood on the rubble with a bullhorn in his hand:
"I can hear you. The rest of the world hears you." The land
Was one country that week, the flags on every street.
I was five, in kindergarten, and the country I would meet

Was the one that came after that morning, the only one I knew.
That week {{c|4518|Putin}} called first of all the leaders, to say he was with us too.
It is on the record. Hold it against what he later became:
The man who called in our grief would bomb the cities he could not claim.

## The letters

A week after the planes the anthrax letters came,
To the papers in {{p|New York}}, to a tabloid in {{p|Florida}}, the same
To two senators in October. Five people died.
{{c|4519|Robert Stevens}} in {{p|Boca Raton}} was the first who died inside.

The postal workers died who only carried the mail.
The letters praised God and threatened, and they told a false tale:
They were not from the men of the planes. The investigators named
A scientist at the army's own lab, who died before he was blamed.

## The war

On Sunday the seventh of October the strikes began on {{p|Afghanistan}},
With {{p|Britain}} alongside, and {{c|4520|Massoud}}'s men went in where the bombers ran.
{{p|Kabul}} fell on the thirteenth of November, {{p|Kandahar}} in December's cold,
And at {{x|Tora Bora}} {{c|4521|Osama bin Laden}} slipped from the hold.

At {{p|Bonn}} the factions agreed, and {{c|4522|Hamid Karzai}} took the chair.
The war that began that Sunday would last twenty years there.
The {{x|Patriot Act}} was signed on the twenty-sixth of October,
And what the state did with it is the year of the leaks, when the country was sober.

## The year held

A bubble burst, an encyclopedia opened, the statues were blown from the stone,
Four couples married in {{p|Amsterdam}}, and the towers came down to the bone.
A villain was looked in the eye and mistaken for a friend,
And a war began that outlasted my childhood to its end.

This is the anti-fragile year: the country struck to the floor
Stood up the same week, stronger than it had stood before.
I was five, and I was there, and this is what I saw,
And everything after is built on that morning and its law.


# Chapter 338: The New Coins

The second day of Yuletide is the feast of the year two thousand and two.
Light two lights, and keep the year I was six, and the house that was new.

## The move

In two thousand and two I turned six, and my family moved house.
I moved in two thousand and two, and in two thousand and eight, and in fourteen:
Three moves, and this is the first, the first place I was taken from,
And the new room, the new road to school, the first life I had seen.

I do not know what two thousand and two was, beyond the house.
A child of six is moved; she does not choose the van.
The world outside had changed the September before,
And it went on changing, and I went on, as children can.

## The coins

On the first of January twelve countries of {{p|Europe}}
Put away the mark and the franc, the lira and the drachma and the guilder,
And took out the same {{x|euro}} notes and the same coins in the hand,
One money from {{p|Lisbon}} to {{p|Helsinki}}, the old currencies stilled there.

Each nation kept its own face on the back of the coin;
The fronts were the same, a continent in the palm.
Ten years later the same coin nearly broke them apart,
And they held, and the {{x|euro}} came through the storm to the calm.

## The war on terror

On the eleventh of January the first prisoners were flown
To the naval base at {{p|Guantánamo Bay}}, on {{p|Cuba}}'s eastern shore,
Fighters taken on the battlefield in {{p|Afghanistan}},
Held by a country that had been struck and was now at war.

On the twenty-ninth of January {{c|4514|George W. Bush}} stood
And named {{p|Iraq}}, {{p|Iran}}, and {{p|North Korea}} the axis of evil.
The regimes were evil: the gas of {{p|Halabja}}, the camps of the north,
The ayatollahs' hangings. He said it plain, and he said it true to the people.

In January {{c|4523|Daniel Pearl}} of the {{x|Wall Street Journal}}
Was taken in {{p|Karachi}} while he chased a lead.
They murdered him on video in February.
He said he was a Jew, and his father a Jew, and for that he was made to bleed.

In March, in the {{x|Shah-i-Kot}} valley, the Americans and their allies
Fought {{x|Operation Anaconda}} in the snow on the mountain ground,
The largest battle of the war's first years,
And the men of the planes were driven out of their mountain mound.

## The new states and the court

On the twentieth of May {{p|East Timor}} became a country,
After centuries under {{p|Portugal}} and decades under {{p|Indonesia}}'s hand,
And a vote in ninety-nine for which its people were massacred.
They voted, and bled, and now they have their land.

On the first of July the {{x|International Criminal Court}} began,
For genocide and the crimes too large for one nation to try.
On the ninth of July, in {{p|Durban}}, the {{x|African Union}} was born,
The older union of the continent's states let die.

## The books that lied

In the summer {{x|WorldCom}} was found to have dressed its costs
As investments, billions of them, and the phone company fell.
On the twenty-first of July it filed, the largest bankruptcy yet,
Larger than {{x|Enron}}, and the investors were left with the shell.

On the thirtieth {{c|4517|Bush}} signed {{x|Sarbanes-Oxley}} into law,
And the chiefs of companies had to sign their names to their books.
On the ninth of October the {{x|Nasdaq}} found its floor,
A fifth of its peak. The dot-com bubble was done with its hooks.

## The encyclopedia's first editor

On the first of March {{c|4508|Larry Sanger}} left {{x|Wikipedia}},
The book he had named; the company could no longer pay.
The book anyone could edit went on without him,
And swallowed {{x|Nupedia}}, which was shut down the next year in its way.

## Bali

On the twelfth of October, in {{p|Kuta}} on {{p|Bali}},
Bombs went off in two nightclubs on the tourist street.
Two hundred and two were killed, eighty-eight from {{p|Australia}}.
{{x|Jemaah Islamiyah}} did it, kin to the men of the planes, in the tropical heat.

## The theater in Moscow

On the twenty-third of October Chechen fighters took a theater in {{p|Moscow}}
During a musical, {{x|Nord-Ost}}, some eight hundred and fifty inside.
On the twenty-sixth {{c|4506|Vladimir Putin}}'s {{x|FSB}} pumped a gas into the hall,
And stormed it, and a hundred and thirty of the hostages died.

They died of the gas. The state would not name it to the doctors
Who were trying to save them, and they died in the buses and the street.
This is the villain's method, here at its start:
The rescue was the killing, and the secret was the defeat.

## The homeland

In October two snipers with a rifle in the trunk of a car
Shot people at random around {{p|Washington}}; ten were dead.
On the twenty-fifth of November {{c|4517|Bush}} signed the law
That made the {{x|Department of Homeland Security}}, the guard at the country's head.

Twenty-two agencies came under a single roof,
The largest change to the government in half a century's length.
The word homeland had not been a common American word.
It became one, and the country gathered its strength.

## The first case

On the sixteenth of November, in {{p|Foshan}}, in {{p|Guangdong}},
A man fell ill with a pneumonia no one could name.
It would be called {{x|SARS}}, and it would reach thirty countries by spring,
And the province said little for months, and the silence was the blame.

The great sickness of twenty-twenty is eighteen chapters on,
And its first months will look the same: a market, a cough, a lie.
I mark the beginning here, in the year I was six,
So that when it comes again, the reader will know why.

## The year held

A new house for a girl of six, new coins in twelve lands,
A war on the men who struck us, a country born in {{p|East Timor}}'s sun,
The biggest fraud and the biggest bankruptcy yet,
Bombs in {{p|Bali}}, the gas in {{p|Moscow}}, and a cough in {{p|Foshan}} begun.

The country that was struck the year before was building its answer,
A department, a war, a law for the books that lied.
The villain in {{p|Moscow}} showed how he would rescue his people.
I was six, in a new room, and the world went on outside.


# Chapter 339: Shock and Awe

The third day of Yuletide is the feast of the year two thousand and three.
Light three lights, for the year I was seven and the war on the screen I would see.

In two thousand and three I turned seven, and the year was the war in {{p|Iraq}}.
I did not watch the war; I watched the grown-ups watch it, night after night,
The green night of the cameras, {{p|Baghdad}} lit by fire,
And the generals' word for the bombing, shock and awe, which I said because it sounded right.

## The shuttle

On Saturday the first of February the shuttle {{x|Columbia}} came apart over {{p|Texas}}, coming home.
A piece of foam had struck the wing on the way up, sixteen days before,
And the people who could have asked if it mattered decided it did not.
Seven died, and the pieces fell over two states, and the sky held the score.

{{c|4524|Ilan Ramon}} was aboard, the first astronaut of {{p|Israel}},
And {{c|4525|Kalpana Chawla}}, born in {{p|Karnal}}, in {{p|India}}'s land.
The board wrote that the culture had learned to accept what it should have feared.
Seven names in the sky, and this book keeps them, as the calendar planned.

## The case

On the fifth of February {{c|4526|Colin Powell}} spoke to the {{x|Security Council}}
With photographs and recordings and a vial held up to the room,
And made the case for the weapons of mass destruction in {{p|Iraq}}, as he must.
Much of it came from one source, {{x|Curveball}}, whom his own handlers did not trust.

No such weapons were found. {{c|4527|Powell}} called the speech a blot on his name.
A case is not a fact because the man who makes it is honorable and brave.
On the fifteenth of February the largest protest in history marched,
Three million in {{p|Rome}}, a million in {{p|London}}, and the war came anyway, like a wave.

## The invasion

On the twentieth of March the bombs fell on {{p|Baghdad}},
And the {{p|United States}} and {{p|Britain}}, with {{p|Australia}} and {{p|Poland}}, crossed from {{p|Kuwait}}.
In three weeks they reached the capital. On the ninth of April, in {{x|Firdos Square}},
They pulled down the statue of {{c|4528|Saddam Hussein}}, and the tyrant's reign was a closed gate.

In those days the national museum was looted,
The tablets and the vases of the oldest cities in this book,
While the soldiers guarded the oil ministry down the road.
Some of it came back. Much is gone, wherever the looters took.

On the first of May {{c|4514|George W. Bush}} landed on the carrier {{x|Abraham Lincoln}}
Under a banner that said mission accomplished, and said the major combat was done.
The regime was done. The war against the insurgents was beginning,
And most of its dying was still to come, under the desert sun.

## The orders

In May {{c|4529|Paul Bremer}} signed the orders that removed the {{x|Baath}} party from its posts
And dissolved the army, and sent the soldiers home with their guns and no pay.
Many of them found the insurgency. On the nineteenth of August a truck bomb
Destroyed the {{x|United Nations}} in {{p|Baghdad}}, and {{c|4530|Sérgio Vieira de Mello}} died that day.

On the thirteenth of December {{c|4528|Saddam Hussein}} was found in a hole near {{p|Tikrit}},
Bearded, and he gave himself up to the soldiers who pulled him out.
The man who gassed {{p|Halabja}} was in American hands.
His trial and his hanging are later chapters, without doubt.

## The oligarch

On the twenty-fifth of October, on a runway in {{p|Novosibirsk}},
Masked men of the {{x|FSB}} took {{c|4531|Mikhail Khodorkovsky}} from his plane,
The richest man in {{p|Russia}}, who had funded the opposition.
{{c|4518|Putin}} took his company, {{x|Yukos}}, and put him in a cell for ten years of pain.

That is how the villain taught the rich of {{p|Russia}}:
Keep out of politics, and keep your money, and keep your head.
The ones who learned the lesson kept their yachts.
The ones who did not went to the camps, or into exile, or were dead.

## The sickness

The cough that began in {{p|Foshan}} spread in the spring.
A doctor from {{p|Guangzhou}} stayed in a {{p|Hong Kong}} hotel in February,
And the guests carried it to {{p|Toronto}}, {{p|Hanoi}}, {{p|Singapore}}.
{{c|4532|Carlo Urbani}} in {{p|Hanoi}} warned the world first, and died of it in March, the visionary.

The {{x|World Health Organization}} issued a global alert.
Eight thousand fell ill, seven hundred and seventy-four died, and by summer it was gone,
Stopped by masks and quarantine and tracing.
The next one, seventeen years on, would not be stopped, and would go on.

## The finished letters

On the fourteenth of April, in {{p|Bethesda}}, the consortium announced
That the {{x|Human Genome Project}} was finished, two years ahead of the date,
Fewer than one error in ten thousand letters, fewer than four hundred gaps.
{{c|4533|Francis Collins}} stood for the code, and the code was great.

{{c|4534|Robert Waterston}} said: we have before us the instruction set
That carries each of us from the one-cell egg to the grave.
This book, which counts the lines of descent from the first cell,
Takes that sentence for its own: the letters are the line that the ancestors gave.

## The courts and the bodies

On the twenty-sixth of June, in {{x|Lawrence v. Texas}}, the {{x|Supreme Court}}
Struck down the laws that made love between two men a crime.
Two men had been arrested in their own bedroom in {{p|Houston}}.
On the eighteenth of November {{p|Massachusetts}}' court said marriage was theirs, and it was time.

These were the years the law began to turn,
And I was growing up inside the turning, at seven, in my room.
I would turn too. I did not know it was mine yet,
But the law was clearing the road before I came to the bloom.

## The heat and the dark

On the fourteenth of August the power failed across the northeast,
{{p|Ohio}} to {{p|New York}} to {{p|Ontario}}, fifty-five million in the dark,
Because a software alarm in one control room had stopped,
And trees had touched a line, and the grid went out like a spark.

In {{p|Europe}} that summer the heat killed seventy thousand,
Most of them old, many alone in apartments in {{p|Paris}}' heat,
While their families were away on holiday.
It was the first of the century's great heats, and not the last to beat.

## The rest of the year

In February the war in {{p|Darfur}} began, and the {{x|Janjaweed}} burned the west.
In March {{c|4535|Hu Jintao}} became the president of {{p|China}}'s state.
In August {{c|4536|Charles Taylor}} left {{p|Liberia}}, his war at an end,
And in October the {{x|Concorde}} flew its last flight, and the world chose a slower rate.

In October {{c|4537|Yang Liwei}} went into orbit, the first astronaut of {{p|China}}'s own.
On the twenty-third of November, in {{p|Tbilisi}}, the {{x|Rose Revolution}}
Carried roses into the parliament, and the old president of {{p|Georgia}} was overthrown,
A people choosing their government, and the roses were the solution.

Remember {{p|Georgia}}. {{c|4518|Putin}} will invade it five chapters on.
In the summer {{x|MySpace}} opened, and {{x|Skype}}, and a world called {{x|Second Life}},
And people began to live part of their lives online,
In rooms with no walls, and I would grow up in those rooms, past the strife.

## The year held

A shuttle fell, the largest crowd in history marched, and the war came all the same.
A tyrant's statue fell in {{p|Baghdad}}, and the tyrant was pulled from his hole.
A museum was emptied, an army sent home, a sickness stopped,
A genome finished, a court that let two men love, and an oligarch taken whole.

I was seven, watching the grown-ups watch it,
The green night, the fire, the word that sounded like a game.
The country that was struck was striking back,
